description: Defines a Dialog class for Windows GUI dialogs, including methods for dialog management, control handling, and radio button groups.

classes.name: Dialog
classes.description: A class encapsulating Windows dialog box behavior, including dialog lifecycle, control management, and radio button groups.

classes.name: Dialog::RadioGroup
classes.description: A helper class for managing a group of radio buttons within a dialog.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts the dialog box with specified instance, parent window, and dialog resource ID.

methods.name: doalogProc
methods.description: Static callback procedure for dialog message handling.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Virtual method for dialog setup, meant to be overridden.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Virtual method to update dialog state, can be overridden.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Virtual method to validate dialog input, returns true by default.

methods.name: updateOkButton
methods.description: Updates the OK button enabled state based on validation.

methods.name: command
methods.description: Handles command messages, can be overridden.

methods.name: ok
methods.description: Virtual method called on OK action.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Virtual method called on Cancel action.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the dialog with success or failure status.

methods.name: hDlg
methods.description: Returns the handle to the dialog window.

methods.name: item
methods.description: Retrieves handle to a control item by ID.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a control item.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets text of a control item.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Retrieves text from a control item.

methods.name: getTextLength
methods.description: Gets length of text in a control item.

methods.name: RadioGroup::set
methods.description: Sets the selected radio button in the group.

methods.name: RadioGroup::get
methods.description: Gets the ID of the checked radio button.

methods.name: radioGroup
methods.description: Creates a RadioGroup object for managing radio buttons.
